notes.title: Huge new Table Manners patch now available
notes.content:
Hello again, Table Manners players!

Echo Chamber Games here. Thank you so much for all your feedback so far - both good and bad! It's been incredibly helpful for the team to see what's working well, and what we need to take a closer look at.

We're super pleased to say [b]our patch is now live[/b], which addresses the following:[list]
[*] Controller support is here! Once you've passed the initial setup screen, just plug in an Xbox or PS4 controller to start playing. Controller keys can binded on the settings menu. You can find the default bindings below:
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/b18c07267130079c41756d91f3bea5c0e6397186.png[/img]
[list]
[*] We’ve fixed lots of bug and crash errors, including item respawns and missing animations. If you launch your newly updated game and your customisation items are missing, fear not! Just visit the customisation area - your items are still unlocked so just re-apply them

[*] Ketchup-based objectives are now much easier, thanks to reduced the Ketchup tolerance (yes that's a thing)!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/94bed56b15000a832e0c1cec564789d1cf206a55.gif[/img][list][*] Champagne bottles now respawn correctly

[*] Left-handed mode was been tweaked. For example, chopsticks are now held correctly - as is the ring in the final level (shh!)

[*] Pepper and Salt UI has been changed to make each pot easier to identify
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/ffc34043f7fb19c530b91bfaf36a06484e5953bd.gif[/img][list][*] Arrow keys can now be binded from the settings menu

[*] Fixed an issue when the Achievement '#MagnumOps' (complete all levels in liquid of courage) was unlocked after rebooting the game

[*] Chopsticks are now easier to detach. When you use a chopstick, press the left-click to grab. When you see the rounded icon, that means the chopstick is about to detach. Press the left-click again to keep them.

[*] You can now pick up fish and other small items with utensils, just as nature intended!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/742906d78810b8b2891875101675eece46cd1b54.gif[/img]

[list][*]Additional fixes:
[list][*]Ending level - champagne now respawns correctly
[*]Level 4-3 - removed unexpected collision issue
[*]Tutorial - fixed issue where the beer was not respawning
[*]Fix issue on some levels where the data animation was making it harder for the player to complete the objective
[*]Fix issue with save data not compatible with previous versions
[*]Fix an issue where the player will get damaged if holding food for too long
[*]Dating App - reduce the amount of repetitive message
[*]Arrow keys can now be binded
[/list]
[/list]Think this patch has improved the game? [b]Then we'd love it if you updated your review on Steam![/b]

Stay tuned to this channel for more updates as soon as we have them.

Lots of love,
Echo Chamber Games

notes.title: It’s Date Night: sassy dating sim Table Manners is out today!
notes.content:
Hello from the team here at Echo Chamber Games!

We're so excited to finally say that [b]Table Manners: The Physics-based Dating Game is out on Steam today, handing romantics the world over the chance to find love in the middle of abject chaos![/b]

Taking on the role of a disembodied hand with a knack for catastrophe, this tongue-in-cheek experience hands people the challenge of finding love when even the simplest of exercises - like pouring a glass of wine for your would-be partner, or lighting a candle to aid the ambience - is a mammoth make or break task.
[previewyoutube=b0zT-at719k;full][/previewyoutube]
Add in some especially unique settings - dates aboard a cruise ship, or a mile up in the air on a private jet are anything but everyday occurrences - and you’ve got an experience where every moment is utterly fraught with danger and hilarity, and fit to rival any real-life liaison you may have lined up for this year’s Valentines. Table Manners also features a ‘left-handed mode’ to ensure everyone can get it on the affair.

We're so proud of the game and can't wait for you to all get your hands on it. It's been a labour of love for the whole team, and it's going to be amazing to see the weird and wonderful things you all get up to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/a5f98b22c377cdf3d997eb31bc22c3181b0eef3a.gif[/img]

[b]But wait! Before you head off for your first date, here are some handy tips to help you on your way:[/b]
[list][*]Just like the real world of dating, there's actually a goal to all this madness. Make your way through enough dates and [b]someone might have a special question for you…[/b]

[*]If your precious ketchup bottle goes tumbling to the floor, don't fret: [b]any object that isn't obtained via the in-game ordering menu will respawn on the table[/b] faster than you can say, 'when'

[*]Mix it up! The more varied your dates, the more rewards you'll ultimately unlock - just like real life! [b]Aim for the most hearts to achieve even more unlockables[/b]

[*]Grab yourself a G&T and keep your eyes peeled for a [b]booze-fuelled level modifier called 'Liquid Courage'[/b] that puts a drunken spin on the world of dating

[*]Be sure to check out the Table Manners' built-in [b]'How to play' guide[/b] in the main menu if you get stuck along the way

[*]Having trouble picking up that pesky pepper pot? Don't forget [b]you can customise your controls at any time in the settings menu[/b]. Note: One hole for salt, many holes for pepper
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/8b69ac35a3dbeda6c2b09dbbf89965f8fb90caf5.gif[/img]

[b]Table Manners launches today on Steam for PC for £14.99/€16.99 /$17.99.[/b]

Let us know what you think, and look forward to chatting with you in the forums!

Lots of love,
Echo Chamber Games xxx
